sandboxPreflight.scope: Standalone runtime probe of the declared filesystem/network rules. The installed Claude client still enforces its own native sandbox and file-tool restrictions. This probe does not claim binary equivalence between the two runtimes.

authentication: Existing claude.ai subscription only; no API keys, provider credentials or personal MCP configuration are inherited.
isolation: The frozen 3.3.0 application and private scratch are writable; supplied target CLI and candidate are read-only. The native sandbox permits only public NuGet/npm registry hosts, denies the SDK checkout and unrelated home/temp files, and allows the .NET runtime shared-memory/lock directories required for first-run restore. No Docker, personal MCP servers, hooks, web tools or delegation. The task explicitly permits managed instruction/adaptor updates; independent acceptance verifies exact ownership and source preservation. macOS trustd.agent is allowed for native TLS certificate verification; direct shell egress remains denied.
buildPolicy: The target CLI performs the upgrade and lock regeneration in its private temporary staging area. Third-party dependencies may restore from the two declared public registry hosts; NGB package identities must match the supplied immutable candidate. Preflight proves transport and filesystem boundaries before any inference; the independent oracle performs clean locked builds afterward.
attemptPolicy: One attempt per task and working directory; no automatic retry, conversation resume, human hints or acceptance-feedback repair. Record actual model, usage, client-side cost estimate, transcript and produced source. A process completion alone is not acceptance.
